correctness.rationale: The defining cocycle equation is solved for arbitrary nondegenerate symmetric matrices. The commutator and both anti-pre-Lie identities hold symbolically. The affine Lie automorphism group is complete; its action reduces every form to either the exceptional off-diagonal form or a diagonal square-class form. The inverse invariant-form space for each canonical product is one-dimensional, proving exact scalar fibers. All isomorphism separations, stabilizers and finite-field orbit counts follow by direct equations and orbit-stabilizer. Exact computation independently enumerates all forms and affine isomorphisms over F3, F5, F7 and F11.

value.rationale: A nondegenerate commutative 2-cocycle is exactly the motivating construction of anti-pre-Lie products. On the smallest nonabelian Lie algebra, its moduli over arbitrary fields have a genuine descent obstruction: the two known complex classes split into one exceptional orbit plus quadratic twists, yielding three finite-field types rather than two. The complete pair of quotient calculations distinguishes 2q−1 raw cocycle orbits from just three induced-product classes and identifies all q² fixed-bracket structures and stabilizers; this is a natural, motivated classification, not a random numerical slice.
